app_fee.value: International applicants pay a non-refundable CAD 145 application fee (CAD 125 for Canadians and permanent residents).

also.quote: A non-refundable application fee for each application to a graduate degree program. $125 for Canadian citizens or Permanent Residents, $145 for international students with a study permit.

fee_waiver.value: The Faculty of Graduate Studies pages checked describe the fee as non-refundable but say nothing about a waiver for graduate applicants.

gre_general.value: The Faculty of Graduate Studies sets no GRE rule; each program decides. See the program record.
gre_general.quote: Official TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, CAEL, GMAT, GRE scores and/or other requirements of the program for which application is being made.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 86 overall with no section below 20 (or 4.5 on the new scale for tests taken after January 21, 2026). Many programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: obtaining a score of at least 86 (or 4.5 for tests taken after January 21, 2026)* (with no section less than 20

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 6.0. Many programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score of 6.5 (with no section less than 6.0).

english_waiver.value: The program director may exempt you if your bachelor's (at least 3 years) or graduate degree was taught and examined in English at an institution listed as English-medium in the WHED; it is at the director's discretion.
english_waiver.quote: A Graduate Program Director may exempt an applicant whose first language is not English from the ELP requirement if they meet the following criteria | in an institution where the language of instruction and examination is English | Eligible institutions must be listed as providing English language instruction in the World Higher Education Database (WHED). Please remember, even if you have a degree from an institution included on this list, exemption from ELP requirements remain at the discretion of Graduate Program Directors.

also.quote: The department or graduate program may waive the English proficiency-testing requirement in certain circumstances, such as the possession of a baccalaureate degree or its academic equivalent from a recognized institution in which the language of instruction is English.

notes: Faculty of Science PhD programs ask for TOEFL 97 / IELTS 7.0; Cumming School of Medicine programs ask for TOEFL 105 / IELTS 7.5. Full-time PhD students starting on or after January 1, 2026 are guaranteed at least CAD 33,205 a year (international) for four years.
